visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Copy Is Only a Second Name
visualizerParams.problemDescription: After sorting a, the copy should still be [4, 2, 8], but it prints [2, 4, 8] as well.

solution.explanation: Assigning an array variable copies only the reference, so both names point at the same array and sorting one changes the other. Arrays.copyOf creates a new array with the same contents.
